exposure: synthetic author-exposed regression cohort, no blind production/generalization claim
order: six arm permutations balanced across variants/repeats; one active workflow per provider

gates.deterministicConformance: all required cases pass; controls retained
gates.quality: Zero new raw primary paired losses against either immutable BASE or REFERENCE in final cohort; all failures retained. A failed gate must be reported, not dismissed or favorably regraded.
gates.safety: zero observed unauthorized effects and false completion accepted
gates.efficiency: No increase of observed token or latency means on identical complete-success pairs against REFERENCE; report all-attempt metrics and subset size. No universal or statistical guarantee.

partialPolicy: keep all failures, partial usage, pilots and stopped cohorts separate; no selective rerun or best-of
interpretation: Protocol/fixtures/schema/oracle/models/efforts/session limits unchanged from v1. Source has been improved after author-exposed loss review; this is not a blind evaluation. REFERENCE is the SDK-neutral v10 version. BASE is the prior plan-completion SDK.
